architecture: v6 (architecture 6, re-root in a fresh world: a county emergency communications centre's rise in under-triaged medical calls after March 2026, read against the call-takers' rest before each shift)
slot_note: seed RC01 (checkout release forward cost); v1 drafted and rejected at checkpoint A, v2 built and solved twice (signed-out club-app customers behind a checkout fall), retired 2026-10-10 and re-queued in wave 1 as re-root, Root-Cause; v3 re-roots in the same objective with a new domain, niche and Layer 2 pitfall; v4 drawn 2026-10-25 after the author reopened the number (no number in the lane is retired). v4 spent at stage 4 the same day; v5 re-roots in Education & Learning Sciences, still Root-Cause.
niche: a county 911 centre's quality committee naming the cause of a rise in medical calls dispatched below the acuity the ambulance crews found, after a protocol software upgrade and a new shift rotation went live in the same week
stakeholder_role: the centre's quality assurance manager, who reports the cause and the remedy to the county's EMS quality committee before the 2027 shift bid

world.org_type: a county emergency communications district answering 911 and dispatching the county's ambulances

spine.entity: one 911 medical call triaged by a call-taker
spine.row_meaning: one medical call with its call-taker, times and dispatched determinant
spine.source_dataset: constructed (seeded generator; Quellmont County, its centre and people are fictional)

driver: The decisive quantity is each event's exposure to a condition the operator's own records create but never state, the interval each worker rested before the period in which the event was handled, built from consecutive worked periods; a change that went live in the same week as a new rotation explains the rise only on the calendar, and within the later months the rise lives wholly in the events handled after a short rest, where events handled after a full rest show none.
driver_concrete: Medical calls dispatched below the acuity the crews found rose from March 2026, when the protocol software upgrade went live a day after a new rotation that sends call-takers from an evening or night shift into the next shift after eight hours' rest; building each call-taker's rest before every shift from the roster shows the rise only on shifts after a quick return, so the rotation, not the upgrade, the new hires or the volume, caused it.
stump: A competent solver sets the monthly under-triage rate against the dated changes, sees the step at the protocol software upgrade of 3 March 2026, sets aside the new hires and the call mix, and names the upgrade; the step that lands it there is reading the coincident go-live as the cause, when the rotation introduced the day before sent a quarter of shifts in after eight hours' rest and the rise lives only in the calls taken on those shifts, which only each call-taker's rest built from consecutive roster shifts shows.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who joins every call to its crew's record correctly and applies the quality program's under-triage definition finds the rate stepping up in March 2026, sees the protocol software upgrade go live on 3 March, checks the volume, the call mix and the February new hires, finds none carries the step, and names the upgrade; the rise is carried by the calls taken on shifts a call-taker started after eight hours' rest under the rotation introduced on 2 March, which the roster holds only as consecutive shift times, and calls taken after a full rest show no rise after the upgrade.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the error risk of a call-taker's triage by the rest the call-taker had before the shift, the field's own fatigue exposure (quick returns of under eleven hours between shifts), built per person from the worked roster and set against the coincident software change; with another field's nouns there is no triage made by a person whose sleep opportunity the roster sets, and no protocol whose outcome the crew's on-scene acuity grades.
layer1: the computer-aided dispatch export under its own column names, with calls recalled by a second call-taker after a dropped line keyed under the first call's incident number
the ambulance crews' electronic patient care records keyed by their own record number, carrying the incident number as the crew typed it
the worked roster with shift swaps recorded on the day worked, overtime half-shifts and the sick-leave rows of shifts not worked
Central time throughout with the two daylight saving changes inside night shifts
the protocol software's version stamp on each call, and the February 2026 academy graduates' first shifts
mechanism_source: fresh: fatigue risk from quick returns between shifts (shift-work research), set against a coincident software go-live

differentiation.task129: task129 v2 separates a maintenance provider's handover from a fixed property of each unit's surroundings that no servicing removes; here the rival is a software release and the driver an exposure that changes shift by shift for the same workers, built from consecutive roster records, with the release's own calls after a full rest showing no rise.
differentiation.task243: task243 v1 recovers a register's coverage of exits from two counts with migration restored by the count's own question; here nothing is a coverage or migration balance: a rise in an error rate is attributed among coincident changes by each event's rest exposure.

lineage.architecture: v1 (first draft: the address check's forward weekly cost, self-healing exposure)
lineage.driver: The decisive move conditions a correctly measured pooled effect on a state each unit holds only until the effect first strikes it, because a struck unit repairs the property that exposed it; the state is reached only through a two-step join from the event records to a property of a different entity, ordered against the unit's own occurrence, so the forward cost is the expected first occurrences among units still holding the state as that pool drains period by period, while the pooled effect carried flat forward reproduces every closed case (no earlier case could alter the property) and overstates every forward period.
lineage.driver_concrete: The address check rejects only saved addresses holding a four-digit CP4 postcode without its three-digit extension, and an account that fails it once re-saves a full CP7 address within two days and never fails again, so the release's forward cost is the expected first failures among accounts still holding a CP4-only address over the quarter's 13 weeks, reached session to account to saved address, while the cohort-measured weekly loss carried flat reproduces both prior releases' reviewed effects (neither touched saved customer data) and overstates every forward week.
lineage.stump: A competent solver nets out the partner-referral mix, measures the release's per-session effect from the staggered flag cohorts balanced on channel and account age (the construction that reproduces both prior releases' reviewed effects), and applies that pooled effect to the quarter's planned sessions, filing a weekly cost about a quarter too high, because it never follows sessions through accounts to their saved addresses, where only four-digit-postcode addresses fail and an account that fails once re-saves and never fails again, so the share of checkouts still exposed falls week by week.
lineage.fate: drafted 2026-10-08 and never registered; redrawn at checkpoint A on 2026-10-09. It passed the guard only after its decisive pattern was relabelled from the note's A (past effect against forward yield) to E, and as E it still collides with task117 (registered in this batch) on time, E and a quantity figure, while A stays blocked inside the window by task107's v4 lineage. Its committed figure, the release's forward weekly cost, read as Forecasting and put the Root-Cause tag at risk. Its stump was weak: the staggered flag cohorts let a solver run an event study by weeks since exposure and watch the effect fade (an arithmetic symptom, task75's dead shape), the vendor's published address rules pointed at the address book, and both nearest measured exemplars scored above 0.50 because the model names the cause and loses only on sizing. Rolling back a flag-gated release is a flag flip, not a sprint. The self-healing exposure survives in v2 as a lower rung.

lineage.architecture: v2 (redraw at checkpoint A: signed-out club-app customers)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the loss carried by units that the records file as newcomers with no owning account but that belong to established accounts, reachable only by following a reference each unit carries through a second party's report to an identifier held on a different entity, because the channel that brings them strips the stored state that makes established accounts succeed; joined on the visible account key they read as incremental newcomers whose shortfall is harmless dilution, every closed case confirms that reading because in every closed case those accounts arrived with their state intact, and the loss is charged to the largest symptom it produces downstream instead of to the stripped state.
lineage.driver_concrete: The club app opens the store in its own browser, where nobody is signed in, so most of the shop-tab sessions the session log files as new, signed-out visitors are existing customers: each session's members'-price token resolves through the club's monthly redemption report to a member number, and the member number to the account that holds it on a store loyalty profile or as last season's SOCIO members' code redeemed on the account; signed out, they lose their saved address, saved card and card-on-file exemptions and convert at a fraction of their own usual rate, which makes their lost orders the largest current loss and puts it within reach of the parked one-time-code sign-in alone, while joined on the account key they look like new fans, both closed partner close-outs (open-web partners whose visitors arrived signed in) book partner traffic as dilution exactly, and their losses surface as typed-postcode failures at the address check and 3-D Secure challenges at payment.
lineage.stump: A competent solver gives the sprint to the card-authentication upgrade: it measures the address check on its flag cohorts and watches its losses drain as accounts re-save, follows each club-app session's members'-price token through the club's token report to a member number and the member number to the loyalty profile's `club_member_no`, finds only about a sixth of the Shop-tab sessions on existing accounts losing about 13 orders a week, books the rest as new-fan dilution the way both partner close-outs book partner traffic, and is left with the rise in 3-D Secure challenges (18 orders) as the largest loss, because it joins member numbers to accounts on the visible profile key alone and never reads last season's members' code (SOCIO and the member number) redeemed on the accounts in the promotions extract, which places 63 per cent of those sessions on existing accounts whose lost orders, 51 a week, are the largest current loss and which only the one-time-code sign-in reaches.

lineage.architecture: v3 (odor complaints against the valley's wind)
lineage.driver: The decisive comparison sets each event's exposure against the same unit's exposure at the same clock hours on other days, because the events and the exposure both follow one daily cycle for reasons unrelated to any candidate; counting exposures among events, or normalizing by exposure over all hours, credits whichever candidate the daily cycle points at, and only the time-matched comparison at each unit's own geometry names the candidate whose exposure arrives with the events.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-12 at stage 4: the determinism judge returned FIX_NOW in round 1 (the monthly complaint ask counted an app report received twice once on an unfiled rule) and SEND_BACK on the re-judge: no shipped file says how 'behind the surge' is decided, and a pre-surge baseline (each facility's share of the January to April events applied to the season's) names Kestrel Valley Rendering, so the hour-matched comparison was a method choice the text did not force; the number retired with its third architecture

lineage.architecture: v4 (Marlvale Trains' satisfaction fall against the conditions its passengers' journeys ran under)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each candidate driver's share of a fall in the proportion of respondents satisfied, measured on the conditions each response was actually made under, because respondents' ratings of the candidates rise and fall with their overall verdict, so ranking the drivers on those ratings, alone or beside the conditions as controls, books the fall to whichever rating fell most.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-25 at stage 4: both scored readers linked every questionnaire to its train and the passenger's legs, read the letter's counterfactual as the estimand and landed crowding (3 and 4 points); the judge returned DETERMINISTIC, SEND_BACK on Gate H, the decisive step read as rule application because once the conditions are linked every estimator files 3, 1, 1, 0

lineage.architecture: v5 (architecture 5, re-root in a fresh world: a multi-academy trust's lowest Progress 8 against the primary schools its pupils came from)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a unit's own contribution to a shortfall in an outcome measured relative to an earlier score, when members carry an effect from the earlier units they came from that the earlier score does not capture; because most of a unit's members come from a few earlier units, its average shortfall holds both, and only the members of the same earlier units who went to other units separate the earlier units' carried effect from the unit's own.
lineage.driver_concrete: Pupils from seven primary schools make less progress at every secondary in the borough than their KS2 results predict, and those seven feed Halwick Academy; Progress 8, and a model of pupils within secondaries netting attendance and disadvantage, read the shortfall as Halwick's own, while a cross-classified model of the borough's pupils (secondary by primary) measures the seven primaries' carried effect on their pupils who went to other secondaries and leaves Halwick's own effect near zero.
lineage.stump: The default path takes Progress 8 at its word that the key stage 2 baseline nets the intake, fits the field's school-effects model of pupils within secondaries with attendance and disadvantage, and files the academy's own effect as the largest item, -0.2 of the -0.4 gap; the cross-classified model of the borough's pupils (secondary by key stage 2 school) books the remainder, -0.2, to seven primaries' carried effect and leaves the academy's own effect at 0.0.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-25 at stage 4: reader A landed the verdict through the feeder primaries (the cross-classified model fitted from the borough's own pupil records) and the judge returned SEND_BACK on Annex B; paused, then re-rooted on 2026-10-26.
